items.title: Bay of Bengal: Moderate swell and SW monsoon residual activity
items.summary: Wave heights 1.5-2.5 m expected along Odisha-AP coast for next 48h. Minor impact on lighterage and berthing windows.

items.title: BDI firming on Capesize strength; Pacific iron ore fixtures active
items.summary: Baltic Dry Index holding above 1400. Capesize rates supported by Australian and Brazilian demand. Booking window remains sensitive for next 2-3 weeks.

items.title: VLSFO Singapore near USD 580-600/mt range
items.summary: Bunker prices stable to slightly softer. Impact on voyage costs for longer routes (Brazil, USA) remains material.

items.title: Haldia draft and queue watch - monsoon residual
items.summary: Average waiting time elevated. Prefer Paradip or Vizag for time-sensitive iron ore / coal if draft allows.

items.title: Low pressure area monitored over North Andaman Sea
items.summary: Models indicate possible intensification. Monitor 72h outlook for East Coast arrivals.
